verdict.rationale: Stripe documents an official MCP server that lets AI agents interact with the Stripe API, and it documents payouts to bank accounts. In-person Terminal payments are managed alongside online payments in Stripe, so an agent could plausibly pull this data. However, the pack never documents listing transactions, balance transactions or payouts via the API, nor any reconciliation reporting. missing for 10: documented API endpoints for listing payments/balance transactions and payouts, payout-to-transaction reconciliation reports, daily settlement or ledger export, hands-on corroboration of agent-driven reconciliation.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent pull transactions and payouts via API and reconcile daily takings into my ledger

citations.quote: The Stripe Model Context Protocol (MCP) server provides tools that AI agents can use to interact with the Stripe API
Stripe sends funds from your available balance to your bank account as payouts.
you can accept in-person payments and manage them alongside your online payments in Stripe
